_README: Reference data for matching this palette to Pantone Solid Coated. READ THIS BEFORE TRUSTING A MATCH. Every sRGB value below is a published screen approximation of a Pantone ink, not a measurement of one. A match computed from it is a starting point for a conversation with a printer, never a substitute for a physical Pantone book or a press proof. The set is deliberately small and covers only the regions this palette sits in; add entries as they are confirmed. If a proof shows a better match, correct it here and rerun tools/match_pantone.py, so the derivation stays reproducible rather than becoming a number nobody can explain.
space: sRGB approximations of Pantone Solid Coated

noMatch.White: White is unprinted stock, or opaque white ink where the stock is not white. It carries no Pantone number.
